buildSentences.display: The students learn important concepts in class.

It is essential for students to participate actively.
The professor encouraged discussion during the lecture today.
Many students prefer to study together in groups.
The library offers a variety of resources for research.
Online courses have become more popular in recent years.
Participating in extracurricular activities can enhance the college experience.
